brief:
Congress is set to vote Tuesday on legislation that critics say would benefit cryptocurrency executives and President Trump, according to Zeteo. The bill's passage would require Democratic support to advance, raising questions about whether the party will back the measure.

Rapper Macklemore has faced consequences for expressing support for Palestine, according to Zeteo. The incident reflects ongoing friction around public statements on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
dek: Congress is set to vote Tuesday on a bill to enrich crypto execs and the president. Elsewhere, Macklemore is the latest to find out free speech is not guaranteed when voicing support for Palestine.
title: Congress to vote on cryptocurrency bill benefiting Trump and industry executives
